The table represents some points on the graph of quadratic function g.

\begin{tabular}{c|c|c|c|c|c|c}
x & \frac{1}{2} & 1 & \frac{3}{2} & 2 & \frac{5}{2} & 3 \\
\hline
g(x) & \frac{7}{4} & 4 & \frac{19}{4} & 4 & \frac{7}{4} & -2
\end{tabular}

What is the range of g?

options.label: A
options.text: All real numbers less than or equal to \frac{3}{2}

options.label: B
options.text: All real numbers less than or equal to \frac{19}{4}

options.label: C
options.text: All real numbers greater than or equal to \frac{3}{2}

options.label: D
options.text: All real numbers greater than or equal to \frac{19}{4}
